text:
natalie: Quick heads-up  legal pushed an update to regional phrasing. They want us to stop using 'data residency' and 'sovereignty' in customer-facing docs and swap to 'in-country data hosting' + 'regional availability'. This affects FR, CA, HK pages and a handful of SDK examples that show endpoint hints. Can someone own a targeted sweep and a tiny SDK snippet update?

liam: I can do a sweep of the markdown pages and update the region matrix. I'll avoid changing any technical content, just wording and crosslinks. Planning to open a single PR that touches docs and examples.

sophie: I'll take the SDK examples (go + ruby). I noticed we only had node/py samples in the earlier drafts, so adding go/ruby keeps parity. Will add an in-line caveat: "Hosted routing hints vs. Dedicated/Private controls."

kevin: Ops note  for Dedicated customers we must not imply hosted routing changes data residency. Add a short callout linking to /private-deployments/kms and mention HSM behavior for on-prem. Also, product asked to surface model parity per-region in the region table with a short footnote.

liam: Draft ripgrep command I used: `rg --hidden "\b(data residency|sovereignty|data-residency)\b" -n docs/` then reviewed results. Found 12 occurrences; narrowed to 7 user-facing pages.

sophie: Example Go snippet (routing hint):
```go
// Hint the hosted API to prefer eu-hosted variants
resp, err := client.Responses.Create(ctx, api.ResponsesCreateParams{
  Model: "redwood/gpt-large",
  Input: "Summarize sales deck",
  Headers: map[string]string{"X-Redwood-Region": "eu-west-1"},
})
```
Ruby snippet:
```rb
# routing hint for hosted endpoint
resp = client.responses.create(
  model: 'redwood/gpt-large',
  input: 'Résumé trimestriel',
  headers: {'X-Redwood-Region' => 'eu-west-1'}
)
```
Add note: "These headers are routing hints on Hosted only. Dedicated/Private customers should configure region in their deployment manifest."

natalie: Nice. Please include a small generated cURL example too so sales folks can demo quickly.

kevin: Also add a short logged example showing that Dedicated deploys use `deployment.region` in YAML, not headers. That prevents confusion in support tickets.

liam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9899 (WIP). Changed wording across FR/CA/HK pages, updated region matrix, added a short "how routing works" explainer block. Left TODO for translations.

doc-bot: @docs-bot lint run  flagged 3 remaining pages that reference 'sovereignty' in examples. See /lint-report/2420001111.

translation-queue: tagging localization team: please plan French and French-Canadian translations for the updated FR/CA pages. Labeling `i18n: fr, fr-CA`.

kevin: For the region matrix footnote: add "Model parity varies by region; see model catalog for current availability." Link to https://docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog. Product wants that explicit.

sophie: cURL snippet for quick demo:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large","input":"test"}'
```
I'll add that under each language snippet.

liam: Updated PR description with checklist: replace phrasing, add SDK examples (go/ruby), update region table, add crosslinks to Private/Dedicated. Marked translation tasks.

natalie: Legal asked we include a link to the internal phrasing guide: https://internal.redwood/legal/region-phrasing (v2). Put that in the PR description so reviewers can eyeball exact wording.

doc-bot: CI: staging build queued for PR #9899. Linter stage complete (2 warnings).

kevin: One more tiny ask  for HK page add a short note clarifying that 'in-country data hosting' refers to storage location of request logs and user content; tokenization metadata may still be processed in the serving region. Keep it high level.

liam: I added that note to the HK page and pushed a commit. Also updated the region table to show HK: 'In-country data hosting: yes (storage)'.

translation-queue: We've accepted the i18n task. ETA 48 hours for FR/FR-CA. Will comment on PR when ready.

doc-bot: CI: staging build passed for PR #9899. Ready for review.

natalie: Thanks everyone. Sophie/Keven can you both add short reviewer notes on the PR so I can merge once translations land? I'll post a one-line note in #general after merge. :tada:

liam: Merged at 2420001899 after translations landed. Release note: "Updated regional phrasing to 'in-country data hosting' and added SDK routing hint examples (go, ruby, node, python)."

sophie: Follow-up: I'll open a tiny follow-up to add a test that ensures generated codeblocks include the routing note. Keeps examples consistent.

kevin: Support doc updated to reference the new phrasing.

natalie: Closing thread. Good ship.
